data.gender_notes: Pharell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pharell is a name of Hebrew origin, derived from the Hebrew word ‘perach’, meaning ‘shining one’. It is a name fitting for someone who represents brightness, light, or illumination. In biblical times, it was believed that God was the source of all light and that He would bring illumination to those who followed Him. The name Pharell carries the meaning “Shining one, light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Pharell usually hope their child will grow to embody shining one, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pharell total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Φαρέλλ
